title.narrative: Deep Decarbonisation Innovation for Steel and Cement Industries (DDI)

description.narrative: The steel, metals and cement sectors in Brazil account for 75 % of the country’s industrial greenhouse gas emissions. These sectors require technical support to demonstrate the feasibility of deep decarbonisation solutions at an industrial scale, substantial capital for investments, and access to renewable energy, sustainable raw materials, and waste resources. This project will drive the scale-up of deep decarbonisation solutions and low-carbon production methods through technology roadmaps, a digital innovation platform for material circularity, demonstration plants featuring breakthrough technologies, mobilised private capital, and a centre of excellence to train local experts. Furthermore, it will develop scale-up plans, financial mechanisms, and provide support to federal government stakeholders in proposing policies and standards to ensure the long-term adoption of decarbonised production methods, generating multiplier effects beyond Brazil and the target sectors.
